title: He made $2.2M from building simple apps. Here's how (no-code)
description:
Start building & deploying paywalls in 10 minutes flat: https://superwall.com/

Private dinners for $100k/mo app founders: https://75v4gfh4e3l.typeform.com/to/CgZbJWb6

Spy on outlier TikToks that went viral promoting apps: https://spytok.com/

Join a community of world class consumer app founders and growth hackers: https://joinconsumerclub.com/

Hosted & produced by Joseph Choi: https://twitter.com/JosephKChoi
Dan: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dantioxidants/

Dan Kwon made $2.2M by building braindead simple apps — and in this podcast, I dig deep into exactly how he did it. We talk through his process for coming up with simple app ideas, his no-fluff approach to app development, and why overcomplicating things is what kills most projects.

If you've ever wanted to break into tech, understand the real-world side of mobile app development, or hear directly from someone who scaled up without a massive team or fancy setup, this episode is for you. Dan breaks down his business model, the mindset behind launching quickly, and how to turn a basic app into a serious income stream.

We also get into lessons for software developers, aspiring founders, and anyone looking to create a lean, scalable business with just coding, focus, and execution.
